cause_attribution_note: Components are measured, non-negative stage waits. They can overlap when identity discovery happens inside the same run as the price. Residual is the unexplained remainder, not a provider excuse.
limitations: Actual competitive start is not persisted in the current schema; it is reported as NOT_STORED rather than inferred from a result timestamp.
Provider fixture updatedAt is the provider's last fixture change, not the price observation time.
Stage waits can overlap when discovery and price capture occur in one run.
Budget pressure is measured from the request ledger separately; it is not attributed per fixture.
